newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander sells 8.5 pct of Airtel to BT.
newsitem.headline: Santander sells 8.5 pct of Airtel to BT.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander has reached an agreement to sell 8.5 percent of mobile phone operator Airtel to British Telecommunications (BT), a Santander statement said on Wednesday.
BT will also buy Santander's stake in Spain unit BT Telecommunications S.A..
No price for the deal was specified.
Santander said it maintained a stake of 5.5 percent in Airtel.
A spokesman for BT said the firm was "working to convert BT Telecommunications into a global operator in the Spanish market."

Unconfirmed press reports on Wednesday citing sources close to the operation said Santander obtained some 50 billion pesetas for the sale of a 10 percent stake in Airtel, which would represent a profit of around 40 billion pesetas.
The reports said Santander was expected to sell its remaining Airtel stake to BT as well.
